name: List Threads
description: Retrieves a list of threads. [See the documentation](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/api-reference/conversations-conversations-inbox-&-messages-v3/public-thread/get-conversations-v3-conversations-threads)

configurable_props.name: associatedContactId
configurable_props.label: Associated Contact ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the contact to filter threads by

configurable_props.name: association
configurable_props.label: Association
configurable_props.description: You can specify an association type here of TICKET. If this is set the response will included a thread associations object and associated ticket id if present. If there are no associations to a ticket with this conversation, then the thread associations object will not be present on the response.

configurable_props.name: archived
configurable_props.label: Archived
configurable_props.description: Whether to return only results that have been archived

configurable_props.name: inboxId
configurable_props.label: Inbox ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the conversations inbox you can optionally include to retrieve the associated messages for. This parameter cannot be used in conjunction with the associatedContactId property.

configurable_props.name: property
configurable_props.label: Property
configurable_props.description: A specific property to include in the thread response

configurable_props.name: after
configurable_props.label: After
configurable_props.description: The paging cursor token of the last successfully read resource will be returned as the paging.next.after JSON property of a paged response containing more results.

configurable_props.name: limit
configurable_props.label: Limit
configurable_props.description: The maximum number of results to display per page
